name: redeemid/member-account
title: Member Account
description: A customer's own membership: their levels, when they joined and renew, what they get, when it last synced (with a refresh), links to manage their Shopify account and subscription, and requests for a copy or erasure of their data. Guests get a sign-in link. A Blockstudio dynamic island: the cached page carries a placeholder and each visitor's fragment fills it in.

attributes.label: Join page, for customers without a membership
Offer Download my data and Delete my data
